item.title: Joan Lunden reflects on groundbreaking career, new book with former GMA colleague Bill Ritter
item.description: She sat down with our own Bill Ritter, her longtime co-worker, to talk all about it, including her advice for young people starting their careers in the news business and taking a trip down memory lane.

item.title: Pentagon IDs 4 American troops killed in Kuwait
item.description: The Pentagon on Tuesday identified four of the six American troops killed in the opening hours of the war with Iran.

item.title: State Department prepares evacuation flights as cancellations strand travelers
item.description: While the government focuses on Americans in the Middle East, travelers in other parts of the world are also feeling the impact of cancelled flights. Lauren Cozzi of Center City is among those stranded.

item.title: Police K-9 helps troopers find 40lbs of marijuana in Delaware County
item.description: Pennsylvania State Police say they found 40 pounds of marijuana during a recent traffic stop on I‑95 in Delaware County.

item.title: 'Felt like I was hunted': Women share frightening encounters of being followed in Northern Liberties
item.description: One woman saidshe was followed for 15 minutes from Northern Liberties to Fishtown. After she shared her story online, another woman reported a similar encounter.

item.title: Montco driver charged with DUI after nearly crashing bus with 54 students: Police
item.description: Authorities say they found an open 750‑milliliter bottle of Tito's vodka on the bus, along with two empty 50‑milliliter bottles.

item.title: Passenger recalls mid-flight return to Philly as war with Iran closes airspace
item.description: What was supposed to be a trip from Philadelphia with a final destination to Dubai became a 16-hour flight back to Philadelphia.

item.title: AccuWeather: Damp and dreary workweek for the Philadelphia region
item.description: The rest of the work week remains damp and dreary before another taste of spring arrives this weekend.

item.title: New details released on chemical leak in Chester County, Pa. creek
item.description: The company reported that chlorinated water was released into a containment area, where it mixed with a substance known as Long Duration Foam, AC‑645. That foam then leaked into the creek.

item.title: Man fatally shot by police after hours‑long standoff in Wilmington
item.description: The incident began around 3:50 p.m. along the unit block of Ramsey Road in Wilmington.
